name: After recital L
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: Lb. whereas the direct funding of media by the state or by public bodies is liable to create dependencies between media outlets and the political powers that provide that funding, hence undermining editorial independence and information pluralism; whereas this financial dependence can produce self-censorship effects, steer the editorial line towards the positions of the government providing the funding and narrow the range of voices heard in the public debate, in violation of Article 11 of the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights;
